description: This file implements Redis's HyperLogLog algorithm, including data structures, encoding/decoding, adding elements, merging, and command implementations for PFADD, PFCOUNT, and PFMERGE, along with debugging and self-test functions.

methods.name: createHLLObject
methods.description: Creates a new HyperLogLog object with sparse encoding.

methods.name: isHLLObjectOrReply
methods.description: Checks if a key's value is a valid HyperLogLog object.

methods.name: pfaddCommand
methods.description: Implements the PFADD command to add elements to a HyperLogLog.

methods.name: pfcountCommand
methods.description: Implements the PFCOUNT command to get the approximate cardinality.

methods.name: pfmergeCommand
methods.description: Implements the PFMERGE command to merge multiple HyperLogLogs.

methods.name: pfselftestCommand
methods.description: Performs self-tests on the HyperLogLog implementation.

methods.name: pfdebugCommand
methods.description: Provides debugging operations for HyperLogLog objects.
